prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE DESIGN COMP, landscape 1536x1024, for the Portuguese public portal Bahia do Sul, presenting a territorial proposal and Professor Guilherme. Not a poster: visible website navigation, content sections, buttons, links, and next-section content. Reference 1 is the existing logo: preserve identity and use compactly on a white header. Reference 2 contains the authentic portrait of Professor Guilherme: use ONLY that same man's portrait in a rectangular editorial photo; preserve face, age, gray hair, dark green polo; no invented person or added gestures. Reference 2's layout must NOT be copied. Fixed palette navy #052957, forest #14752b, ocean #0074ad, white, restrained gold #ffb511. Editorial serif headings and clear sans body. Real text only: 'Bahia do Sul', 'Nossa terra. Mais futuro.', 'Conheça o projeto', 'Explore o território', 'Professor Guilherme', 'Conheça sua relação com o projeto', 'Conhecer Guilherme', 'Acompanhar no Instagram', 'Entenda o projeto'. Main nav: 'O projeto', 'Território', 'Professor Guilherme', 'Participar'. No invented statistics, quotes, endorsements, official seals, vote counts or titles of elected office. Landscape imagery illustrates Atlantic rainforest, cacao and southern Bahia coast, not a claim of an exact photographed location. Keep all text readable and restrained, buttons large. Composition: a premium but familiar civic PORTAL WEBSITE. White horizontal header. Standard wide landscape hero 340px, left-aligned headline and two buttons. Then a separate white two-column candidate section with modest real portrait on LEFT and title, paragraph and green button on RIGHT. Below a pale-blue band with three clearly separated destination links 'O projeto', 'Território', 'Participar'. Generous spacing, restrained serif, traditional predictable navigation. This must differ visibly from a magazine sidebar layout and from a chapter-led cinematic journal. Keep classic portal structure polished.
